digest.component_or_area: Jira reconcile bridge outbound comment sync
propositions: The outbound comment sync re-posted duplicate comments to Jira on every hourly pass because the comment-id dedup map (comment_ids) was inert/empty, leaving only a lossy body-membership fallback for deduplication.

REB-1861 reached Jira's 5000-comment hard cap, causing new comments to fail with COMMENTS_PER_ISSUE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED; the fix requires deleting 29,931 duplicate bot-authored comments across 30 affected issues (30,847 marked + 836 distinct bodies = 836 to keep).

Phase 1 executed and verified: 29,931 duplicates deleted via keep-oldest-per-distinct-normalized-body rule; all 30 issues post-deletion report zero remaining duplicates and are below the cap (REB-1861: 5000→79); independent backup-vs-live verification confirms zero missing distinct bodies and unchanged non-candidate counts.

Phase 2 (836 truncation-suffix comments across REB-1567, REB-1931, REB-2605) was deliberately not executed; they lack the RECONCILER_MARKER because outbound truncation at 32767 chars removed the trailing marker paragraph, but they are identifiable by _TRUNCATION_SUFFIX and same bot accountId and can be deleted separately behind --include-truncated.

The reconcile-bridge workflow remains paused (disabled_manually) and was not re-enabled; 150MB pre-deletion backups written before any deletion; 29,931-line append-only deletion log; 713+ rate-limit throttles (429/Retry-After) absorbed with zero failed deletions.

A separate defect (marker-loss during truncation) was identified: the reconciler truncates at 32767 chars after appending the marker, dropping the marker paragraph; truncating to (limit - len(marker)) before appending the marker would preserve the loop-breaker.
